About MEERAM

MEERAM Business Solutions brings technology, accounting and business-support services together for small businesses, freelancers and startups. The name MEERAM combines Meera and Ramsurat, honouring the founder’s parents.

Our goal is to help you spend less time on repetitive tasks and paperwork, and more time on customers, better decisions and business growth. We connect you with a network of dedicated IT and office-support professionals for practical, coordinated assistance.

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
